title: My friend group trying to put up one Christmas tree
idea: Friends try to, episode 7 (posts 28 Nov 2026): the light knot, the spell round the staff, Viking's taut pull, Reaper's turning stand and a perfect spiral; Viking's boot peels it all off

hook.what: the light knot springs round the Wizard's hat; the lead is looped round Viking's boot

do.reason: the glass bulbs jingling as a loop of the knot springs round the Wizard's hat
the Wizard's spell lifting the knot
the knot spinning round the staff
the string of lights snapping taut across the room
the empty ornament carton tipping over
the string springing back and landing on them
the string winding up the tree
the spiral finishing at the top: a gentle chime
the series sting on the tiny undo (the same in every episode)
the lead snagging on Viking's boot
the spiral unwinding fast toward his boot
the star landing softly on the rug

visible.why: frame 0: the knot round the Wizard's hat, the bare tree, the lead round Viking's boot
the spell winds the glowing knot round his own staff
Viking pulls the string taut across the room and knocks the carton over
the string draped over the Wizard's hat and Viking's shoulders, the two glaring at each other
Reaper holds the end and turns the stand: the string winds on in a perfect spiral
WE DID IT: all four cheering at the result
THE GLARE: three annoyed faces turned to Viking, his sheepish grin
the heap at Viking's boot, the star on the rug, the cat beside it

allowClip.reason: Reaper's mitten on the branch tips, pushing the tree round on its stand
